response.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT d.A3 AS region, CASE WHEN tr.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN tr.amount WHEN tr.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -tr.amount ELSE NULL END AS signed FROM trans tr JOIN account a ON tr.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE CAST(tr.date AS TEXT) BETWEEN '1996-05-09' AND '1998-01-06'), r AS (SELECT region, AVG(signed) AS avg_signed, COUNT(*) AS n FROM t GROUP BY region), o AS (SELECT AVG(avg_signed) AS overall FROM r) SELECT r.region, r.avg_signed, r.n, r.avg_signed / o.overall AS ratio FROM r CROSS JOIN o WHERE o.overall IS NOT NULL ORDER BY r.region;
